lines.text: In Lagos, an importer sends a thirty percent deposit to a supplier in Shenzhen.
lines.say: In Lagos, an importer sends a thirty percent deposit to a supplier in Shenzhen.

lines.text: The seventy percent balance is where it goes wrong.
lines.say: The seventy percent balance is where it goes wrong.

lines.text: Goods that never arrive. Over three billion dollars lost in 2025 to "our bank details have changed" scams.
lines.say: Goods that never arrive. Over three billion dollars lost in twenty twenty-five to "our bank details have changed" scams.

lines.text: A naira that lost a third of its value in a single day. And letters of credit have almost vanished.
lines.say: A Nyra that lost a third of its value in a single day. And letters of credit have almost vanished.

lines.text: Arra is Latin for earnest money: the deposit that secures a deal.
lines.say: Ahra is Latin for earnest money: the deposit that secures a deal.

lines.text: Pay the deposit, and keep the balance locked in an open contract on Celo.
lines.say: Pay the deposit, and keep the balance locked in an open contract on Sello.

lines.text: Before any order, paste the page you found your supplier on. Arra's agent pays half a cent per lookup to read it, and searches X and Reddit for complaints.
lines.say: Before any order, paste the page you found your supplier on. Ahra's agent pays half a cent per look-up to read it, and searches X and Reddit for complaints.

lines.text: This example shop has two customer complaints: high risk.
lines.say: This example shop has two customer complaints: high risk.

lines.text: A real seller comes back green. And suppliers can confirm their own page, so impersonators get flagged.
lines.say: A real seller comes back green. And suppliers can confirm their own page, so impersonators get flagged.

lines.text: Describe the order like a message, and the assistant fills in the terms.
lines.say: Describe the order like a message, and the assistant fills in the terms.

lines.text: Vague words like "good quality" are refused, and the terms are fingerprinted, so they can't change later.
lines.say: Vague words like "good quality" are refused, and the terms are fingerprinted, so they can't change later.

lines.text: Send your supplier one link. They read the terms in English or Chinese, and agree from their own wallet.
lines.say: Send your supplier one link. They read the terms in English or Chinese, and agree from their own wallet.

lines.text: You see their record and reviews, and a changed payout address sets off an alarm.
lines.say: You see their record and reviews, and a changed payout address sets off an alarm.

lines.text: Pay from the wallet you already use: MiniPay, MetaMask, Rabby, or any wallet on Celo. In dollars, or straight from naira.
lines.say: Pay from the wallet you already use: Mini Pay, Meta Mask, Rabby, or any wallet on Sello. In dollars, or straight from Nyra.

lines.text: Lock the order. The supplier accepts, and the deposit reaches them instantly. The balance waits.
lines.say: Lock the order. The supplier accepts, and the deposit reaches them instantly. The balance waits.

lines.text: Every naira payment is a Textile FX fill: one firm quote for exactly the dollars needed, settled in one transaction.
lines.say: Every Nyra payment is a Textile F X fill: one firm quote for exactly the dollars needed, settled in one transaction.

lines.text: That one rate matters. In 2023, a seven-thousand-dollar balance cost two million naira more, just seven weeks later.
lines.say: That one rate matters. In twenty twenty-three, a seven-thousand-dollar balance cost two million Nyra more, just seven weeks later.

lines.text: With Arra, it's paid for on day one.
lines.say: With Ahra, it's paid for on day one.

lines.text: When they ship, the container number is checked, and your check period starts when the goods arrive.
lines.say: When they ship, the container number is checked, and your check period starts when the goods arrive.

lines.text: All good? Pay the balance in one tap, or in parts.
lines.say: All good? Pay the balance in one tap, or in parts.

lines.text: Something wrong? Report it with signed photos, and make an offer.
lines.say: Something wrong? Report it with signed photos, and make an offer.

lines.text: Cancel before they accept. No accept, or no shipment, and Arra's agent refunds you automatically.
lines.say: Cancel before they accept. No accept, or no shipment, and Ahra's agent refunds you automatically.

lines.text: A quiet buyer can't hold the money: ignored offers go through in seven days. And nobody, not even Arra, can send it anywhere else.
lines.say: A quiet buyer can't hold the money: ignored offers go through in seven days. And nobody, not even Ahra, can send it anywhere else.

lines.text: Afterwards, both sides review each other, hidden until both have written. Receipts and history stay with every order.
lines.say: Afterwards, both sides review each other, hidden until both have written. Receipts and history stay with every order.

lines.text: It works for any deposit-and-balance deal: a house built back home, furniture made to order, a freelance project.
lines.say: It works for any deposit-and-balance deal: a house built back home, furniture made to order, a freelance project.

lines.text: Arra is live on Celo mainnet. A friend's real order ran start to finish.
lines.say: Ahra is live on Sello main net. A friend's real order ran start to finish.

lines.text: Verified contract, a registered agent, naira filled through Textile, and supplier checks paid over x402.
lines.say: Verified contract, a registered agent, Nyra filled through Textile, and supplier checks paid over x four oh two.

lines.text: Arra. Trade with anyone, without the worry.
lines.say: Ahra. Trade with anyone, without the worry.
